property_summary: decreaseAllowance must succeed (return true) when the current allowance is exactly the amount subtracted, reducing the allowance to zero; the buggy version requires strictly greater allowance and reverts on exact reduction, breaking the property that for any spender, amount, and subtractedValue with currentAllowance >= subtractedValue the decrease succeeds and yields allowance currentAllowance - subtractedValue.
change_summary: Change the require condition from currentAllowance >= subtractedValue to currentAllowance > subtractedValue, so exact allowance decreases revert instead of succeeding.
